<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_Dismissal"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/dismissal">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Dismissal" name="Dismissal"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MPON" name="MPON" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_MPON" name="Start"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDismissal" name="Send the dismissal" messageRef="Message_Dismissal"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_DismissalSent" name="Dismissal sent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPON_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_MPON" targetRef="Task_SendDismissal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPON_2" sourceRef="Task_SendDismissal" targetRef="EndEvent_DismissalSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MPOO" name="MPOO" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_DismissalReceived" name="Dismissal received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Dismissal" messageRef="Message_Dismissal"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewDismissal" name="Review the dismissal"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DismissalOutcome" name="Dismissal outcome"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OpposeDismissal" name="Oppose the dismissal"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_DismissalOpposed" name="Dismissal opposed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmDismissal" name="Confirm the dismissal"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_DismissalConfirmed" name="Dismissal confirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_DismissalReceived" targetRef="Task_ReviewDismissal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_2" sourceRef="Task_ReviewDismissal" targetRef="Gateway_DismissalOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_Oppose" name="Opposes" sourceRef="Gateway_DismissalOutcome" targetRef="Task_OpposeDismissal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_OpposeEnd" sourceRef="Task_OpposeDismissal" targetRef="EndEvent_DismissalOpposed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_Confirm" name="Confirms" sourceRef="Gateway_DismissalOutcome" targetRef="Task_ConfirmDismissal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_ConfirmEnd" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmDismissal" targetRef="EndEvent_DismissalConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Dismissal">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_MPON" name="MPON" processRef="Process_MPON"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_MPOO" name="MPOO" processRef="Process_MPOO"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Dismissal" name="Dismissal" sourceRef="Task_SendDismissal" targetRef="StartEvent_DismissalReceived" messageRef="Message_Dismissal"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
